notes.title: Patch Live! Improved controls and gamepad support!
notes.content:
Hello!

As promised, the new update is available. We have improved the controls, fixed some bugs and we have added support for gamepad!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28733850/1da39e59e181290680c41a2e5d7aa61572acf2b9.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy the update. Let us know what you think at our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/627420]Community Hub[/url].

[b]Have a great summer! And stay tuned for more news![/b]
